title: Original lanterns: relics, alien tech, living (green + one corps each)
desc: J: "make me original lanterns now" (a mixed bag of ancient relics, alien tech and living/organic; green + one corps; anything goes). Six new designs, each in green and one other corps colour. Nothing starts from the Dark Lantern's pinch or the vault.
